propositions: The LLM step failure tally (ran but did not fail the run) must be extended from review-plan to both review-code and verify-completion gates.
review-code requires activating the sink in its run scope at gate_dispatch.py:480 and draining into coverage.llm_step_failures beside the existing contract-violation drain.

verify-completion requires the coverage.llm_step_failures key placed inside a new coverage object (created only when non-empty) to maintain byte-identity on clean runs and consistency across all three gates.
The step-failure tally shape (required [total, by_step]) must be declared identically in code_review_verdict and completion_verdict schemas.
Clean runs must not create empty coverage objects; the tally key must be absent when no failures were recorded.
The recording site in PydanticAIRunner.run unconditionally calls step_failures.record, so wiring requires only scope activation around each gate and a drain in the verdict assembly operation.
